subject: Post-call: deployment fit & PoC checklist for Acme Health
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie@acmehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up and requirements from today

Thanks again for the demo today — quick notes from our side and a few open items so we can pick a PoC deployment path. High-level needs: 
- Low tail latency for inference (target ~150-250ms p50/p95 depending on prompt length)
- Predictable throughput for daytime hours (bursty but bounded)
- Data residency in the U.S.; sensitive PHI in some payloads (we need controls)
- SOC 2 evidence and basic audit logs for access/usage

Attachments: q3-acme-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet we reviewed)

Big question: do we plan the PoC on Hosted API to move fast, Dedicated to validate SLA/throughput predictability, or start with Private VPC/on-prem because of PHI? We want a recommendation plus a short checklist of what you need from us to start.

Stakeholders we'll loop in: me (PM), Ajay Rao (infra lead), and our security team (security@acmehealth.com). We can be available for a 30–45 minute follow-up this week.

—Julie
Product Lead, Acme Health
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Park <julie@acmehealth.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up and requirements from today

Julie — thanks for the thorough notes and upload. I summarized a recommended path below and a practical PoC approach that balances speed with security validation. Please see the attached one-pager for a timeline and task list (redwood-poc-outline.pdf).

Quick recommendation (short):
- If you need to validate go-to-prod fast and PHI will be pseudonymized during the first phase, start with Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool). Dedicated gives predictable throughput and is the fastest way to test real load without code changes.
- If you must keep any real PHI within your network boundary from day one, choose Private VPC or on-prem for the PoC. That increases setup time (network + KMS + audit hookup) but proves your security controls end-to-end.
- Hosted API is the quickest for experiments but will require strong data-transformation controls and possibly a written data-processing addendum for PHI — not ideal if you need strict residency and isolation.

Suggested PoC plan (2 parallel tracks we can combine):
1) Dedicated track (recommended fast path):
   - Success criteria: p95 latency < 350ms for 512-token avg requests; consistent throughput for a 500 qps daytime window; no functional regressions on prompt set
   - Timeline: 2–3 weeks to provision + baseline runs (we can accelerate with pre-approved infrastructure)
   - What we need from you: sample prompt set (anonymized/synthetic if needed), expected concurrency profile, list of endpoints to test

2) Private/VPC track (security-critical path):
   - Success criteria: KMS-integrated encryption at rest, VPC peering/PrivateLink configured, audit log ingestion to your SIEM within 1 day
   - Timeline: 4–6 weeks (network setup + compliance review)
   - What we need from you: network contacts, KMS details, security questionnaire responses

Owners & next steps:
- Redwood owner: soojin_lee (lead), dylan_brooks (runtime engineer, will run load tests), vanessa_ortiz (solutions lead)
- Acme owners: Julie (PM), Ajay Rao (infra), Security team

Can you confirm which PoC track you'd like to begin with this week? If Dedicated, we can provision a trial pool and schedule the first load run in 10 business days. If Private, we can share a more detailed checklist and calendar availability for network kickoff.

Thanks — attaching the outline now.

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Julie Park <julie@acmehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ajay Rao <ajay@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up and requirements from today

Thanks Soojin — that breakdown is super helpful. We want to run the Dedicated track first to move quickly and validate throughput/latency. We'll run synthetically-masked PHI for the initial runs, then discuss the Private/VPC path once the performance profile is stable.

A few clarifying questions before we lock dates: 
- Can you confirm encryption at rest and in-transit on Dedicated? (we need wording for our security team)
- Is there a sandbox/network dry-run we can do (no real data) to validate connectivity before we provision GPUs?
- Rough estimate of cost for a 3-week Dedicated trial (per your standard trial offering)?

Proposed timeline if you can provision quickly: provisioning week of Sep 28, baseline runs Oct 1–8, review Oct 12. Stakeholders who will join: Ajay (infra), me (PM), Kelsey M. (product), and a member of security for the kickoff.

We'd like Redwood to send a short checklist for security and a one-page summary of Dedicated guarantees for the trial we can share with our procurement/security teams.

—Julie
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Park <julie@acmehealth.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up and requirements from today

Julie — great, thanks for confirming the Dedicated track. Action items below and links attached.

Confirmed: Dedicated trial + synthetic PHI tests.
Security confirmations (for your team):
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest (KMS-managed keys). We'll supply a short statement of controls you can share with security — attaching trial-terms-docusign.pdf with the trial security addendum.
- Sandbox/dry-run: yes — network dry-run available. We'll open a temporary test endpoint and run a connectivity checklist before GPUs are provisioned. No production data required.

Cost & timeline:
- Estimate for 3-week Dedicated trial (provision + baseline runs + review): ~ $18k–$28k depending on selected GPU profile. We'll provide a firm quote once you confirm desired concurrency and model family.
- Timeline: provisioning week of Sep 28; baseline Oct 1–8; review w/c Oct 12. We will reserve capacity for the week of Sep 28 once you approve.

Immediate next steps (owners & deliverables):
- Julie / Acme: confirm concurrency target + anonymized prompt set by Tue, Sep 22
- Ajay / Acme: provide network contact for dry-run + IP allowlist window
- Redwood: will send security checklist, firm quote, HubSpot opp link, and DocuSign trial terms by EOD Mon, Sep 21

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot opportunity: https://hubspot.example/opportunity/ACME-1732
- DocuSign: https://docusign.example/abc123 (trial-terms-docusign.pdf attached)
- Attachment: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (again)

If that schedule works, I'll create the provisioning ticket and loop Dylan for the load-testing plan. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call with Ajay + security to run through the dry-run checklist.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
